summary: Enliven Therapeutics filed a preliminary prospectus supplement for a registered underwritten public offering of $250M in common stock and pre-funded warrants. The offering is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. Deal terms (price per share, discount, net proceeds) are not yet fixed; the filing is subject to completion. The company is the issuer, and the proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. There is no transaction event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing is a standard 424B5 follow-on offering.
